explanation.text: The Logic: Horizontal spread = same type, same strike, DIFFERENT expiries. It's a play on the difference in time values decaying at different rates. Payoff chart cannot be drawn as expiries differ. The Trap: VERTICAL spread = same expiry, different strikes. DIAGONAL = different expiry AND different strikes. Cross-Exam Context: Spread types are tested in Series I and VIII.
